title: Stochastic driver compensation for road gradients across vehicle classes: a machine learning approach.
summary: Expectation-maximization stochastic modeling estimates driver acceleration compensation and road-gradient parameters from GPS trajectories across private cars, vans and a coach; estimates vary with speed, slope and vehicle class.

evidence.unknown: Twenty bootstrap resamples per slope/vehicle combination assess parameter stability; no external fleet validation in reviewed passages. This is observed-trajectory modeling, not causal driver behavior evidence.
